title: purchase_request
description: A resolved, simulated purchase (LEAD_DECISIONS D5). target_direct_weight is the FINAL direct weight of the instrument, not the amount added. The purchase is funded from cash; every other position is unchanged; fees and taxes are excluded. Range and semantic problems (negative, above 1, below the current direct weight, unsupported instrument) are deliberately NOT schema errors: the engine reports them as execution.status INVALID_REQUEST.

target_direct_weight.description: Final direct weight (fraction of the portfolio).

original_words.description: The user's sentence, verbatim, or null when the request was made with structured controls only.

unresolved.title: unresolved_purchase_request
unresolved.description: Free-text request accepted only by POST /investigations. The investigator must resolve it into a purchase_request or ask a clarification; it never reaches the engine in this form.
